title: Mold Remediation Deposit Raise for Category 2 and Category 3 Water Losses
content:
Growth behind a linked Water Damage Mitigation job of water Category 3 raises the Mold Remediation signing deposit by the Category 3 deposit raise of 250.00; growth behind a linked water job of Category 2 raises it by the Category 2 deposit raise of 120.00; every other job takes no contamination raise.

**Desk questions**

*Which record decides the raise?* The IICRC water category on the Water Damage Mitigation job the mold job is linked to.

*What does Category 3 mean for the deposit?* A raise of 250.00.

*And Category 2?* A raise of 120.00.

*A Category 1 water job, or no linked water job?* No contamination raise.

| Linked water job's category | Deposit raise |
|---|---|
| Category 3 | 250.00 |
| Category 2 | 120.00 |
| Category 1 | None |
| No linked water job | None |
